text:
Elena Gomez: Zenith ops asked for the exact CSVs we need so their pricing team can plug into our cost model. Can we finalise a one-paragraph ask + 2-row example?
Marco Silva: Minimal fields for daily availability: sku_id, region, date_utc, total_hours, reserved_hours, spot_hours, avg_spot_price_usd, evictions_count.
Cassie Park (Finance): Commitment table: sku_id, commit_tenor_months, reserved_hourly_usd, min_commit_hours, volume_tier_thresholds, volume_tier_discount_pct, credit_latency_days, tax_inclusive (true/false). Finance needs tax and credit timing.
Ryan (Sales): Vendors often need burst pricing field. Add burst_rate_multiplier and billing_granularity (hour/minute). I'll offer a quick call in the email.
Vendor Integration Bot: Attaching tiny sample rows for vendors to copy:
```
sku_id,region,date_utc,total_hours,reserved_hours,spot_hours,evictions_count,avg_spot_price_usd,avg_utilization_pct,burst_allowed
zenith-a100-40gb,us-west-2,2026-03-10,24,480,3200,1,0.69,0.65,true
zenith-a100-40gb,us-west-2,2026-03-11,24,480,3185,0,0.66,0.63,true
```
Vendor Integration Bot: Commit sample:
```
sku_id,commit_tenor_months,reserved_hourly_usd,min_commit_hours,volume_tier_1_threshold,volume_tier_1_discount_pct,credit_latency_days,burst_rate_multiplier
zenith-a100-40gb,12,2.10,1200,10000,6,14,1.4
```
Elena Gomez: Draft email: "Hi Zenith ops team — quick onboarding request to plug your SKUs into Redwood's marketplace cost model. Please provide a 14-day UTC sample of per-region daily availability (CSV) and your commitment terms CSV using the attached headers. Include eviction examples (eviction_timestamp_iso, duration_minutes, reason_code), billing granularity, tax treatment, and refund/credit policy (credit latency days). Preferred format: CSV UTF-8. If easier, happy to take a short call to walk through. Could we get this by EOD Friday? — Elena on Partnerships"
Marco Silva: Add: ask for timezone of their monitoring so we can reconcile if they send non-UTC.
Cassie Park (Finance): I'll prepare the finance mapping doc once we have CSVs. Deadline EOD Friday works for pricing sync next week.
Ryan (Sales): I'll include a Calendly link for a 20-min walkthrough.
Elena Gomez: Action items: Marco attach csv schema, Cassie prep finance mapping, Ryan add call link. Sending from partnerships@redwood in 30m. :thumbsup:
